title: Early life in Algiers and Sox's Lane
summary: He says he lived in Sox's Lane, far back from the later Navy station, where there were no halls.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was living in Soxer Lane.
I started playing, Sox's Lane, in the Navy. They got all that for the Navy now. Oh, now for the Navy. Yes. They didn't have no Navy there. Way down there.
They had a lane, go all the way back almost about three miles away.
I wonder where some of the old halls were there that you played. Do you remember the Navy?
Well they didn't have no halls there. They had the halls all in Algiers. We used to have to go in Algiers. I've been to Algiers. Yeah, but the way they used to give picnics under the oak trees.
Oh, you had picnics now where you lived?
